project.title: Hong Kong Written Chinese Neologism Dictionary
project.subtitle: Ontology-driven lexicographic exploration of diachronic semantic evolution, 2016–2026

categories.label: Pandemic
categories.description: Pandemic-related vocabulary and contextual changes associated with COVID-19, healthcare, and public-health discourse.

categories.label: Technology
categories.description: Lexical items related to artificial intelligence, digitalization, online communication, and smart technologies.

categories.label: Economy
categories.description: Vocabulary associated with finance, consumption, fiscal policy, banking, and real-estate discourse.

categories.label: Innovation
categories.description: Vocabulary related to science, research and development, technological innovation, and energy transition.

entries.definition: A shortened form referring to the novel coronavirus and, by extension, COVID-19-related discourse.
entries.example_zh: 新冠疫情改變了香港市民的工作和生活方式。
entries.example_en: The COVID-19 pandemic changed the working and living habits of Hong Kong residents.

2020: 新冠病毒在全球迅速傳播。
政府公布新冠防疫措施。
2021: 新冠疫苗接種計劃逐步展開。
2022: 社會開始討論新冠後的經濟復甦。
2023: 新冠逐漸由緊急公共衛生事件轉為常態化健康議題。

entries.definition: The condition and development of an epidemic, increasingly associated with COVID-19 policies and post-pandemic recovery.
entries.example_zh: 疫情期間，香港大幅增加了遙距工作安排。
entries.example_en: During the pandemic, Hong Kong substantially expanded remote-working arrangements.

2020: 疫情令旅遊業受到重大衝擊。
2021: 防疫政策成為疫情報道的核心。
2022: 疫情語境逐漸轉向復常與經濟恢復。
2023: 後疫情時代的消費與工作模式受到關注。

entries.definition: A biological infectious agent; in recent media discourse, strongly associated with COVID-19, cybersecurity, and metaphorical threats.
entries.example_zh: 病毒一詞在疫情期間主要出現在公共衛生語境中。
entries.example_en: During the pandemic, the word virus occurred mainly in public-health contexts.

2019: 電腦病毒攻擊企業網絡。
2020: 新型病毒引發公共衛生危機。
2021: 病毒變種成為新聞焦點。
2024: 媒體同時討論生物病毒與網絡病毒。

entries.definition: Medical and healthcare services, increasingly connected with digital health, smart healthcare, and public-health preparedness.
entries.example_zh: 智慧醫療成為香港數字轉型的重要領域。
entries.example_en: Smart healthcare has become an important area of Hong Kong's digital transformation.

2017: 政府增加公共醫療資源。
2020: 疫情加快遙距醫療服務的發展。
2022: 醫療數據平台受到關注。
2025: 人工智能逐步應用於醫療診斷。

entries.definition: Originally associated mainly with artificial intelligence, later extended to smart devices, vehicles, manufacturing, healthcare, and urban development.
entries.example_zh: 香港正推動智能城市及智能交通建設。
entries.example_en: Hong Kong is promoting smart-city and smart-transport development.

2016: 人工智能技術開始進入商業應用。
2019: 智能手機與智能家居市場快速增長。
2022: 智能汽車與智能製造成為投資熱點。
2025: 智能醫療與智能城市平台進一步整合。

entries.definition: A traditional word meaning wisdom that has expanded productively in compounds such as smart city, smart healthcare, and smart transport.
entries.example_zh: 智慧城市政策推動交通、醫療和公共服務數字化。
entries.example_en: Smart-city policies promote the digitalization of transport, healthcare, and public services.

2016: 智慧主要用於描述知識與判斷能力。
2019: 智慧城市成為政策關鍵詞。
2023: 智慧醫療和智慧交通快速發展。

entries.definition: A network or internet infrastructure; its usage expanded through online work, education, social media, and digital services.
entries.example_zh: 疫情期間，網絡教育和網絡辦公迅速普及。
entries.example_en: During the pandemic, online education and remote work expanded rapidly.

2020: 網絡辦公與網絡教學成為常態。
2023: 社交網絡平台影響公共討論。

entries.definition: Traditionally referring to numbers, increasingly used as a modifier in digital economy, digital governance, and digital transformation.
entries.example_zh: 數字經濟成為香港產業政策的重要方向。
entries.example_en: The digital economy has become an important direction of Hong Kong's industrial policy.

2016: 報告公布最新經濟數字。
2022: 數字經濟與數字政府成為政策重點。

entries.definition: Occurring or available through the internet, with strong diffusion during and after the COVID-19 pandemic.
entries.example_zh: 線上會議、線上購物和線上教學在疫情後持續發展。
entries.example_en: Online meetings, shopping, and teaching continued to develop after the pandemic.

2018: 線上購物市場保持增長。
2020: 企業改用線上會議及線上辦公。
2021: 線上教育平台用戶增加。
2024: 線上與線下服務進一步融合。

entries.definition: A financial institution; recent contexts increasingly include virtual banking, fintech, digital payments, and platform-based services.
entries.example_zh: 虛擬銀行改變了香港傳統銀行服務模式。
entries.example_en: Virtual banks have changed traditional banking services in Hong Kong.

2019: 香港發出虛擬銀行牌照。
2021: 銀行加快數字金融服務。
2025: 銀行運用人工智能改善風險管理。

entries.definition: Consumer spending and consumption behaviour, especially in relation to online commerce, vouchers, and post-pandemic recovery.
entries.example_zh: 疫情改變了市民的消費模式，線上消費比例明顯上升。
entries.example_en: The pandemic changed consumer behaviour, with a clear rise in online consumption.

2020: 疫情重塑市民消費模式。
2024: 跨境與線上消費並行發展。

entries.definition: Government finance and fiscal policy, including pandemic support, public spending, and recovery measures.
entries.example_zh: 政府透過財政措施支援受疫情影響的行業。
entries.example_en: The government used fiscal measures to support sectors affected by the pandemic.

2017: 政府公布新一年度財政預算。
2020: 財政支援措施協助企業渡過疫情。
2023: 財政政策轉向復甦與結構調整。

entries.definition: A shortened form occurring in compounds and media discourse related to property and real-estate markets.
entries.example_zh: 利率與人口變化持續影響香港房地市場。
entries.example_en: Interest rates and demographic change continue to affect Hong Kong's property market.

2020: 疫情影響商業房地需求。
2022: 利率上升令房地市場受壓。
2025: 房地政策更重視長期供應。

entries.definition: Science and scientific activity, increasingly connected with innovation policy, data, health, and technology governance.
entries.example_zh: 科學研究與創新政策在疫情後受到更多關注。
entries.example_en: Scientific research and innovation policy received greater attention after the pandemic.

2016: 大學推動基礎科學研究。
2020: 疫情提升社會對科學證據的關注。
2023: 科學與創科政策進一步結合。

entries.definition: Research and development activities, frequently associated with innovation ecosystems, biotechnology, and artificial intelligence.
entries.example_zh: 香港增加人工智能和生物科技研發投入。
entries.example_en: Hong Kong increased investment in artificial-intelligence and biotechnology R&D.

2016: 企業增加產品研發開支。
2020: 疫苗研發成為全球焦點。
2023: 人工智能研發與產業轉化受到重視。

entries.definition: Energy resources and systems, increasingly used in discourse on green transition, renewable energy, and carbon reduction.
entries.example_zh: 可再生能源與綠色金融成為香港轉型的重要議題。
entries.example_en: Renewable energy and green finance have become important issues in Hong Kong's transition.

2016: 能源價格影響企業成本。
2021: 清潔能源投資逐步增加。
2024: 能源轉型與減碳政策密切相關。
